features.name: Harness Bootstrap
features.behavior: Set up the repository with all harness infrastructure: state files, verification scripts, documentation templates, and startup path
features.verification: Run `make check` — all layers must pass. Confirm init.sh exits 0 on clean checkout. Confirm feature_list.json and progress.md are valid.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix any lint errors reported. Run `make lint` to see error details.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime verification
layers.repair: Ensure all test suites pass. Run `make test` for details.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Run `make check` — all verification layers must pass. Check individual layer outputs for failures.

features.name: Project Scaffold
features.behavior: Initialize the core project structure with source directories, build configuration, and dependency management
features.verification: Run `make check` — all layers must pass. Confirm `make build` produces a working artifact. Confirm package.json has real scripts.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix lint errors. Ensure build config is valid.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime verification
layers.repair: Ensure scaffold compiles and basic smoke tests pass.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Confirm `make build` produces a working artifact.

features.name: First User-Facing Feature
features.behavior: Implement the first concrete behavior. Replace with actual feature description when project scope is defined
features.verification: Run `make check` — all layers must pass. Manual e2e: confirm the feature works end-to-end.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix type errors and lint violations.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime verification
layers.repair: Unit and integration tests must pass for the new feature.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: End-to-end tests must pass. Manual verification: confirm the feature works end-to-end.

features.name: Verification Coverage
features.behavior: Add or confirm tests, type checks, linting, and verification coverage for the active feature set
features.verification: Run `make check` — all layers must pass. Coverage report shows acceptable levels.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: All lint and type checks pass.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime verification
layers.repair: Test coverage meets threshold. Add missing tests for critical paths.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Full check passes. Coverage report shows acceptable levels.

features.name: Documentation Update
features.behavior: Update README, architecture docs, product docs, and quality-document for modules touched during implementation
features.verification: Run `make check` — all layers must pass. Docs match current code state.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Full verification passes. Docs match current code state.

features.name: Cleanup and Handoff
features.behavior: Record verification evidence, update progress.md, run clean-check, and leave a clear next-session path
features.verification: Run `make clean-check` — clean state check passes: build clean, no debug artifacts, startup path works, feature list updated.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Clean state check passes: build clean, no debug artifacts, startup path works, feature list updated.
